business_summary: Shenzhen Agricultural Power Group Co.,Ltd, a holding company, engages in development, construction, operation, and management of agricultural products wholesale markets in China. The company was formerly known as Shenzhen Agricultural Products Group Co.,Ltd. Shenzhen Agricultural Power Group Co.,Ltd was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: 지주회사인 Shenzhen Agricultural Power Group Co.,Ltd는 중국 농산물 도매시장의 개발, 건설, 운영 및 관리에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 Shenzhen Agricultural Products Group Co.,Ltd로 알려졌습니다. Shenzhen Agricultural Power Group Co.,Ltd는 1994년에 설립되었으며 중국 심천에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
